ns2:section.sectionText: John Street Watershed is a local watershed that has a history of flooding. Recently, efforts have been made by residents and the City of Champaign to address that flooding. This course addresses urban storm water management from an ecologically sustainable perspective. Students will explore the human dimensions of this issue by applying social theories regarding attitudes, behaviors and norms, environmental awareness and education, and participatory processes in social movements. Applied survey techniques, message development and transmission, and environmental marketing will be utilized to address existing problems. To request being added to the waiting list for this course, complete the form at http://go.illinois.edu/NRESwaitinglist.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Natural Resrcs & Environ Sci major(s).
